status.en: 8 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 60% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 8 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 60 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Syrian authorities continue to integrate thousands of foreign fighters while the Islamic State threat persists, complicating security efforts. A Syrian farmer was killed by a landmine remnant in Idlib, and two Syrian security officers were killed and four wounded in a raid near Damascus. The Syrian interior minister discussed cooperation with Interpol on cross-border crime. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske myndigheter fortsetter å integrere tusenvis av utenlandske krigere mens trusselen fra IS vedvarer, noe som kompliserer sikkerhetsarbeidet. En syrisk bonde ble drept av en landminerester i Idlib, og to syriske sikkerhetsoffiserer ble drept og fire såret i et raid nær Damaskus. Den syriske innenriksministeren diskuterte samarbeid med Interpol om grenseoverskridende kriminalitet. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
